name: Nippon Insure Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nippon Insure Co., Ltd. provides financial guarantees, mainly covering rent owed for homes and for commercial spaces such as stores and offices. Its guarantees also extend to healthcare costs, including hospital fees, long-term care expenses and nursing care debts, and it offers laundry and fitness services. Dating from 2002 with its base in Fukuoka City, it is a subsidiary of Miyoshi Real Estate Co., Ltd.
